title: Refactor Duplicated Discount Rules
summary: Remove duplicated pricing rules without changing observable behavior.
objectives: Identify duplicated rules as a single source of truth.
Extract a helper while preserving the public behavior.
Use existing tests as a safety net during refactoring.
constraints: Behavior must not change for any tier or price.
Keep both public function signatures unchanged.
Return a new collection from the bulk function.
Do not add a new dependency.

examples.explanation: Standard prices at or above 100 receive a 10% discount.
Premium prices below 50 are unchanged; 60 receives a 20% discount.

public.name: Standard tier
public.description: The threshold and rate for the standard tier.

public.name: Bulk premium prices
public.description: The bulk function applies the same rule as the single function.

hidden.name: Threshold boundaries
hidden.description: Prices exactly at the threshold use the discounted rate.

hidden.name: Unknown tier
hidden.description: Unknown tiers still return the original price.
